ui.purpose: All prose, table cells, nav, form copy. The default register for human-readable content.

label.purpose: Section headers (h2 in cards), table column headers, badge text, stat labels. Always uppercase with tracking.

mono.purpose: Job output panel, file paths, inline code tokens, .env key names, source drawer content. Strictly for machine-generated or machine-readable text.

stat.purpose: Counted quantities on the Files page stat strip. The largest text in the UI — reserved for numeric values only.

shadows.name: panel-overlay
shadows.purpose: Source drawer (right side panel). Indicates physical overlap above the canvas.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Render-warnings popover. Anchored dropdown that overlaps header content.

motion.name: button-fade
motion.purpose: Primary button hover — opacity 1.0 → 0.85. The only transition on interactive controls.

motion.name: nav-color
motion.purpose: Nav link hover and active state.

motion.name: slider-toggle
motion.purpose: Toggle switch track color and thumb translation.

motion.name: details-chevron
motion.purpose: Operations drawer and program section chevron rotation.

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: Running-job indicator. Only visible during active pipeline work.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-priority action. Daily Pulse trigger, Save settings, Run Analysis.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default action weight for Done, Dismiss, Drop, and most table row actions.

components.name: Secondary Button Small
components.description: Table row actions — Done, +1d, +3d, Mon, … overflow menu trigger.
components.css: .ds-btn-sm { background: var(--slds-g-color-surface-1, #fff); color: var(--slds-g-color-on-surface-2, #181818); border: 1px solid var(--slds-g-color-border-2, #c9c7c5); border-radius: var(--slds-g-radius-border-1, 0.125rem); padding: 3px 8px; font: 600 11px/1 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-sm:hover { background: var(--slds-g-color-surface-2, #f3f3f3); } .ds-btn-sm:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--slds-g-color-brand-2, #0176d3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Irreversible administrative actions only — server restart. Never for completion or dismissal.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: var(--slds-g-color-error-2, #c23934); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: var(--slds-g-radius-border-2, 0.25rem); padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 0.875rem/1 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #a61c17; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--slds-g-color-brand-2, #0176d3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Brief State Tabs
components.description: Horizontal tab bar sticky below header. Act / Watch / Waiting / Inbox / Closed.
components.css: .ds-tab-bar { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--slds-g-color-border-2, #c9c7c5); background: var(--slds-g-color-surface-1, #fff); } .ds-tab { padding: 12px 20px; font: 400 0.875rem/1 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--slds-g-color-on-surface-4, #706e6b); border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; white-space: nowrap; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; transition: color 0.1s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--slds-g-color-on-surface-2, #181818); } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--slds-g-color-brand-2, #0176d3); border-bottom-color: var(--slds-g-color-brand-2, #0176d3); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab-count { background: var(--slds-g-color-surface-2, #f3f3f3); color: var(--slds-g-color-on-surface-4, #706e6b); border-radius: 10px; padding: 1px 7px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-count { background: #daeaf8; color: var(--slds-g-color-brand-2, #0176d3); } .ds-tab-count-urgent { background: #fef1f1 !important; color: var(--slds-g-color-error-2, #c23934) !important; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Semantic status badges. Each hue owns exactly one role.
components.html: EXECSOLUTIONDAILYOVERDUEDEFERRED

components.name: Card

components.name: Overdue Banner

2 overdue acts — action required

components.css: .ds-overdue-banner { background: #fef1f1; border: 1px solid #fac9c9; border-left: 4px solid var(--slds-g-color-error-2, #c23934); border-radius: var(--slds-g-radius-border-3, 0.5rem); padding: 14px 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; } .ds-overdue-icon { flex-shrink: 0; padding-top: 2px; } .ds-overdue-body { flex: 1; } .ds-overdue-title { font: 700 0.875rem/1 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--slds-g-color-error-2, #c23934); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-overdue-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-overdue-list li { font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--slds-g-color-on-surface-2, #181818); overflow-wrap: break-word; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Boolean setting control — color mode, shareable pass, Plaud sync. Pill track with sliding thumb.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 36px; height: 20px; } .ds-toggle-input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; position: absolute; } .ds-toggle-slider { position: absolute; cursor: pointer; inset: 0; background: var(--slds-g-color-border-2, #c9c7c5); border-radius: 20px; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-toggle-slider::before { content: ''; position: absolute; height: 14px; width: 14px; left: 3px; bottom: 3px; background: #fff; border-radius: 50%; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-toggle-input:checked + .ds-toggle-slider { background: var(--slds-g-color-brand-2, #0176d3); } .ds-toggle-input:checked + .ds-toggle-slider::before { transform: translateX(16px); } .ds-toggle-input:focus-visible + .ds-toggle-slider { outline: 2px solid var(--slds-g-color-brand-2, #0176d3); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface follows Salesforce's native record-page pattern: a clean white field, a sticky header with a brand-blue underline, horizontal subtabs for major information categories, and related-list tables for scannable row-by-row content. The tool is used by someone who lives in Salesforce — the design language should feel immediately familiar, not like a custom tool that needs to be learned.

The primary Brief State view uses five tabs (Act / Watch / Waiting / Inbox / Closed), so arriving on the page shows only the active obligations at the weight the user chooses. Operational paralysis is eliminated by making sections mutually exclusive rather than stacked. A pinned Today's Focus card (2px blue border) floats above the act table for the most critical items; the overdue banner is always visible above the tabs regardless of which tab is active.

Dark mode is preserved as a toggle (dimly-lit office use), but light is the default. In light mode, the SLDS token system provides the chrome; dark mode applies an explicit slds-color-scheme_dark class and overrides the hardcoded hex values.
keyCharacteristics: SLDS2 Cosmos token system (--slds-g-color-*, --slds-g-font-scale-*, --slds-g-radius-border-*) loaded from CDN
White/light-grey field (Salesforce native); dark toggle preserved
Salesforce brand blue (#0176d3) as the single action color
Brief State as tab-based record page — Act / Watch / Waiting / Inbox / Closed
Related-list tables inside each tab: grey table header row, subtle row hover, right-aligned actions
Semantic badge vocabulary: light tinted backgrounds (not dark), each hue owns one role
Synthesis buttons tiered by frequency: daily-pulse (blue primary), periodic (secondary), rare (muted secondary)

rules.name: One hue, one role
rules.body: Blue = action only. Red = urgency/error only. Never use red for a completion action (Dismiss, Done) — those are secondary buttons. The vocabulary works because it is consistent.

rules.name: The Static Hex Exception
rules.body: Badge backgrounds and the inbox card use direct hex rather than SLDS tokens because they carry semantic meaning independent of the surface color — the tint IS the signal. Overriding these in dark mode requires explicit dark-mode rules, not token inheritance.

rules.name: The Mono Firewall
rules.body: SF Mono appears only for machine-generated or machine-readable text: job output, file paths, env key names, inline code tokens. Never use mono for UI copy, labels, or nav text.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All surfaces are flat at rest. --slds-g-shadow-2 is permitted only for elements that physically overlap the canvas: the source drawer (fixed side panel) and the render-warnings popover (anchored dropdown). Adding shadows elsewhere breaks the uniform depth contract.

rules.name: The Token Radius Rule
rules.body: All radius values reference the SLDS scale vars with a px fallback. Never hardcode a bare pixel value for border-radius on a standard element — the fallback is for environments where the SLDS stylesheet hasn't loaded.

dos: Do use var(--slds-g-color-brand-2, #0176d3) for all interactive affordances: buttons, tab underlines, focus rings, count pills on active tabs.
Do keep the Brief State tab bar sticky (top: 53px) so it's reachable without scrolling past the header.
Do tint overdue rows with rgba(194,57,52,0.04) — the row tint is visible at a glance without requiring a badge scan.
Do use related-list table layout (grey header, row hover, right-aligned actions) for all Brief State content panels.
Do persist the active tab to sessionStorage so returning to the page resumes context.
Do keep the overdue banner above the tabs — it's the only element that renders regardless of tab state.
Do tier synthesis buttons by frequency: Daily Pulse is primary blue; Weekly/Catch-up are secondary; Career/Timecard are rare (muted secondary).
Do use var(--slds-g-shadow-2) only for the source drawer and render-warn popover — elements that physically overlap the canvas.
Do preserve hardcoded hex values for badge backgrounds and the inbox card; these semantic tints must not be inherited from SLDS surface tokens.
donts: Don't stack Act + Watch + Delegate vertically. The tab model is the answer to paralysis — mutually exclusive panels, not a vertical scroll.
Don't use red or destructive styling for completion or dismissal actions (Done, Dismiss, Drop). Those are secondary buttons.
Don't use emoji as icons. The sole exception is the Unicode braille dot (⠿) drag handle in the program order list.
Don't add box-shadows to cards. Flat surfaces differentiated by border only.
Don't load dark mode by default. slds-color-scheme_dark is applied only when localStorage.getItem('slds-ui-color-mode') === 'dark'.
Don't use SF Mono for UI copy, labels, nav, or badge text. Mono is strictly for machine-generated / machine-readable content.

Don't invent a new hue for a new badge type. Extend the existing semantic vocabulary: red for urgency, orange for deferred/inbox, blue for delegation, purple for interpersonal, teal for insight, green for success.
